request: Map build requests to installed or installable capabilities, collect an interactive approval in Chat, fall back to natural-language approval in external runtimes, surface pending plans in chat history and Alerts, and default autonomous work to automatic capability decisions with ask-first overrides.

entries.note: reused the existing context-index batch search and connected-app discovery path to rank installed and installable implementations for typed capability intents
extended the canonical chat message persistence, hydration, and deduplication path so pending capability plans survive restarts and remain attached to their exact chat
reused the established Obsidian-backed agent notification writer and resolution flow to publish capability approvals into the existing Alerts inbox
extended the existing notification action matrix with an exact-chat deep link for capability approval alerts
carried a typed per-task automatic-or-ask capability policy from the canonical Work Board store into Queen Bee dispatch prompts
extended the existing company approval policy matrix so zero-human companies remain automatic by default while allowing an ask-first capability override
